summary: Implemented two features: (1) the registry Update button is now conditionally rendered only when `registryUpdateAvailable` (a new git-based HEAD comparison) is true, and (2) resource discovery was extended so linked Gizmo extension package roots are enumerated, making skills from newly linked packages visible in the catalog.
decisions: Compute update availability via a non-mutating `git ls-remote origin HEAD` comparison against the local clone in `registry-git-build.ts`; a failing source returns false rather than throwing, so the catalog stays usable.
Add an optional `updateAvailable: boolean` field to the `RegistryInfo` protocol schema in `packages/protocol/src/registry.ts`, only emitted when the check returns true.
Render the registry Update button in `ExtensionRegistrySection.svelte` inside an `{#if registry.updateAvailable}` guard.

Discover resources from linked Gizmo extension packages by stat-checking each `linked` directory on disk and falling back to declared `pi.skills` / `pi.prompts` package.json entries plus conventional `skills/` and `prompts/` dirs, via a new `linkedExtensionResourceRoots` exported from `extension-resources.ts`.
